description: This Java class defines an action for creating typed resource files in an Android project within an IDE, including validation, navigation, and default configurations.

classes.name: CreateTypedResourceFileAction
classes.description: An action class for creating and managing typed resource files in Android projects, including validation and navigation.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with this action.

methods.name: createValidator
methods.description: Creates an input validator for the resource file name.

methods.name: invokeDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input the new resource file name.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the resource file and optionally navigates to it.

methods.name: doCreateAndNavigate
methods.description: Creates the resource file, navigates to it, and optionally initiates renaming.

methods.name: doNavigate
methods.description: Navigates to the specified XML file.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the action is available in the current context.

methods.name: getAllowedTagNames
methods.description: Returns allowed root tag names for the resource type.

methods.name: getSortedAllowedTagNames
methods.description: Returns sorted list of allowed root tag names.

methods.name: getDefaultRootTag
methods.description: Returns the default root tag name for the resource type.

methods.name: doIsAvailable
methods.description: Static method to check resource directory availability in context.

methods.name: getErrorTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for error dialogs.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name for creating resource files.

methods.name: getActionName
methods.description: Returns the display name for the create resource file action.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the presentable name of the resource type.

methods.name: getDefaultRootTagByResourceType
methods.description: Provides default root tags based on resource folder type.
